title: Satellite Image Briefing — An idea becomes a connected system

scenes.title: Register, wipe, trace
scenes.purpose: Show two dated overhead plates of the same footprint aligned on a landmark, then reveal and trace the region where one spark became a linked six-site system.
visuals: Procedural SVG overhead plate (fields, river, roads, grid) with landmark crosshair
Dashed T1 registration ghost sliding/rotating onto the landmark
Left-to-right wipe from T0 to T1 plate
Cyan change outline, six site markers and links
Always-visible date tags, coordinates, scale bar and north arrow

beats.development: Shared T0 landscape established; misaligned T1 line-art ghost (64 m E, 46 m N, 4°) slides and rotates onto the landmark; panel switches to PLATES CO-REGISTERED.
Wipe edge crosses the registered footprint, replacing T0 with T1 (cleared parcels, new built footprints and tracks) while the ghost fades.
Dashed region-of-change outline draws, six site markers pop and seven links draw; legend and caption appear.
captions: Δ CHANGE TRACED — 1 spark became 6 linked sites
Same landmark ⊕, same scale, same north. Illustrative procedural plates, not real imagery.

beats.development: Settled hold on the outlined change with both dates visible.
captions: Δ CHANGE TRACED — 1 spark became 6 linked sites

findings: All motion completes by 2.3 s; composition settled before 2.7 s.
Location and north stay fixed across the comparison; only the ghost registration overlay moves.
justifiedHolds: 2.3–3.0 s hold on the outlined change so the caption and dates can be read.

notes: No preview_recipes are listed in STYLE.json and no BACKGROUND_REVIEW.json is supplied; the preview demonstrates the core characteristic action (register two dated plates on a landmark, wipe, trace change).
